assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Key-area route, space, component and interface IDs are proposal tracking identifiers; alignments, dimensions, capacities, addresses and engineering feasibility are unknown.
assumptions.impact: They support coordination and handover review but cannot be used for cadastral, design-development, procurement or construction decisions.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are mechanism references sourced from public institutional pages; local outcomes, metrics, development rights and governance powers are not transferred.
assumptions.impact: Every proposed mechanism still requires Beijing-specific legal, ownership, public-interest and engineering review.

assumptions.statement: The English package is machine-assisted and human-reviewed for structural parity, but it is not an official legal or policy translation.
assumptions.impact: Official Chinese instruments and competent-authority translations prevail in case of inconsistency.
